# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Core drill crews advertise free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold] in the Botanical Dorms, warm side, next to the grow lamps. Shared heater, no spiders seen since the last sweep. Ask for the night gardener. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], any sealed room in the MegaStruct for a core technician coming in from the valley bunkers. Will trade lab hours or a working space heater. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]CORE HANDLERS WANTED[/bold] for the research labs. Steady hands, clean gloves, and no eating near the samples. Again. - [bold]TUG MECHANIC[/bold] needed at the cargo tug repair station. Must be able to work outside in a whiteout and not complain about it on the radio.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]THERMAL LINERS[/bold], double stitched, sized for work suits. Trade for heater coils or real tea. - [bold]SPIDER LAMPS[/bold], bright white floods on a long battery. They do not like the light. Ask at the Blue Warehouse loading door. - [bold]CRAMPONS[/bold], one pair, barely worn. Previous owner has taken a desk job.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: a sample case marked CORE 41, last seen on the Landing Valley path. Please do not open it. Return it to the research hab, no questions asked. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: one left mitten, very large, outside the Anti-Freeze Bar. Claim it at the bar by showing us the other one.
## Notices - The Anti-Freeze Bar is keeping the heaters on all night through the cold snap. Anyone caught outside when the lights fail is welcome in.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
